_meta.note: Fixed-parameter DFM Kalman smoother: statsmodels DynamicFactor.smooth (Q = I) and the generic KalmanSmoother (Q != I; standardized panel) at given parameters, stationary initialization. smoothed_state is T x m and smoothed_state_cov T x m x m (statsmodels' arrays moved to time-first). NaN cells of the panels are null. loglik is that of the panel the smoother saw (the standardized z for the standardized case).

cases.name: standardized_r1_p3
cases.source: statsmodels KalmanSmoother (generic) on z = (X - center) / scale; nowcast = center + scale * (loadings @ smoothed_factor[T-1])
